claims.text: The proposed model is compared with existing MRC systems that extract answers by finding sub-strings in passages.
The proposed model outperforms the R.M.-Reader + Verifier model, which is more complicated and includes several components.
The proposed model is evaluated against a baseline model called Joint SAN, showing improved performance in EM and F1 scores.
